newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends "up or down" in confused trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends "up or down" in confused trade.

text.p: Currency trading on Colombia's interbank market came to a confused close after the peso rose sharply and mysteriouly higher against the dollar in the final minute of trading, dealers said.
They said the peso was at 1,078.30 just two minutes before the close, but in the last minute electronic trading screens suddenly flashed an official close at 1,070.
The local currency closed Thursday at 1,072.85 and traders said everyone expected it to close lower instead of higher.
Traders attributed whatever happened to a computer glitch, but central bank officials could not be reached for immediate comment on whether the peso closed up or down.
Dealers reported 404 trades for a total of $172 million and said there was no sign of central bank intervention.
